verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is an API product, so an interactive API reference is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack never documents an interactive reference, API playground or runnable 'try it' examples. The evidence shows only general docs, SDK guides and an llms.txt index, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
